inventory_scope: Every retained top-level evidence source/version/type/role/timeframe/direction/origin, plus every registered composite scanner cell even if empty. Bundled feature columns are listed separately, not assumed independently evaluated
daily_scope: Current seven registered daily composite scanners, both directions, 5/10/21-session directional and recommendation-plan policies. Exact policy IDs, historical/live origin, run purpose and sample remain separate
sampling: All retained tickers plus each original disjoint 300-ticker manifest, filtered within existing ledger events. This is not a new all-date replay or certification of retained universe coverage
lifecycle: Use first retained occurrence for each security/source/version/direction/origin/run-purpose/lifecycle key. Never choose occurrences by their outcomes. Missing lifecycle keys remain distinct and do not imply independence
availability: Only evidence and latest outcome revisions observed/created by this report cutoff. Retain stale, not-entered and unavailable outcomes in counts; exclude them from performance metrics with explicit reasons
policy_identity: No cost or benchmark revisions are pooled. Live evidence must satisfy the recorded policy effective window. Reconstructed ledger groups with retained outcomes explicitly referencing the exact policy/horizon are reported retrospectively across their full lifecycle-event denominator, including missing outcomes; counts outside the policy effective window remain explicit and block certification. No database policy dates are changed
statistics: Equal-weight signal-date cohorts, then existing XNYS horizon spacing plus non-overlapping execution paths. Report returns, primary benchmark excess, MAE/MFE, hit-rate uncertainty, early/late and fixed later-period views
multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg over all daily registry cells and exact retained policy revisions within each sample/origin/run-purpose family; unmeasurable cells use p=1 internally. No p/q claim of independent trials
scores: Separate coverage and empirical evidence state. No arbitrary numeric quality score, individual-stock probability, live qualification publication or use of the 20% portfolio limit as a detector-quality gate
limitations: Ledger coverage does not certify a complete historical replay or no-signal control population
Existing published qualifications describe their original cohorts, not these newly filtered samples
An evidence research pass is not deployability, input certification or probability calibration
Retained price-return, corporate-action, timing and benchmark quality flags remain attached
Bearish signed returns are directional evidence, not a borrow-cost/short-sale simulation
No new bars, provider calls, model fits, schema changes, live rankings, option gates or paper-tracker changes
